findings.explanation: Neither designated English nor Spanish summary describes a geographic primary service area. The opening paragraph lists participating hospitals, including Little Falls; the mailing address identifies where to apply, not a service boundary. All three PDF pages and visible tables were reviewed.

evidence.quote:
The Financial Assistance Policy (“FAP”) of Bassett Healthcare Network, which includes The Mary
Imogene Bassett Hospital, d/b/a/ Bassett Medical Center (Bassett), A.O. Fox Memorial Hospital (FOX),
O’Connor Hospital, Cobleskill Regional Hospital and Little Falls Hospital (collectively "Bassett Healthcare
Network") is available to patients who are uninsured or underinsured with a demonstrated inability to
pay. Financial assistance applies to medical necessary services that are provided and billed by the
entities above including emergency room care.

La Política de Asistencia Financiera (Financial Assistance Policy, “FAP”) de Bassett Healthcare Network,
que incluye The Mary Imogene Bassett Hospital, que opera bajo el nombre comercial de Bassett Medical
Center (Bassett), A.O. Fox Memorial Hospital (FOX), O’Connor Hospital, Cobleskill Regional Hospital y
Little Falls Hospital (en conjunto, “Bassett Healthcare Network”) está disponible para pacientes que no
tienen seguro o tienen un seguro insuficiente con una incapacidad de pago demostrada. La asistencia
financiera se aplica a los servicios médicos necesarios que son prestados y facturados por las entidades
mencionadas anteriormente, incluida la atención en la sala de emergencias.

findings.search_notes: Read the complete English PDF page 1 and Spanish PDF pages 1–2, including visible income/discount tables, headings, eligibility, application, exclusion and contact paragraphs. No geographic PSA, county list, catchment boundary or residence-based coverage statement appears. Hospital names, service exclusions and the Cooperstown mailing address do not describe geographic coverage. The 15-page resource guide and policy/application documents are outside this summary-only measure.

findings.explanation: Both source-language summaries explain how to obtain an application and where to send the completed application.

application_routes: Obtain online, by phone, on statement or at registration; submit/mail to Financial Assistance Program, One Atwell Road.

evidence.quote:
If you are having trouble paying your medical bill, you may qualify for a discount. Patients are

bassett.org, by calling 607-547-3093, or on your statement as well as in all registration areas.

Envíe su solicitud completa por correo a: Attention: Financial Assistance Program, One Atwell Road,
Cooperstown, NY 13326

findings.explanation: Both summaries expressly describe full assistance below 200% FPL and discounted care above 200% through 400% FPL. Presence only; the narrative/table boundary at exactly 200% is not adjudicated here.

evidence.quote:
Financial Assistance Eligibility: Generally, uninsured and underinsured patients may be eligible for full
financial assistance when their family household income is less than 200% of the Federal Poverty Level
(“FPL”). Patients with household income greater than 200% but less than or equal to 400% of FPL may
be eligible for discounted care.

Elegibilidad para asistencia financiera: por lo general, los pacientes sin seguro y con seguro insuficiente
pueden ser elegibles para recibir asistencia financiera completa cuando el ingreso de su familia sea
inferior al 200 % del nivel federal de pobreza (Federal Poverty Level, “FPL”). Los pacientes con ingresos
familiares superiores al 200 %, pero inferiores o iguales al 400 % del FPL pueden ser elegibles para
recibir atención con descuento.
